user.title: Pulse Check
user.description: Pulse Check watches every device's battery and connectivity using the state Home Assistant already has. It never contacts the devices themselves. Thresholds, filters and notifications can be set afterwards with Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Pulse Check is already set up. One instance watches everything.

thresholds.name: Thresholds
thresholds.description: When a battery counts as low, and how long a device can stay silent.

data_description.battery_warning: A battery at or below this percentage is a warning.
data_description.battery_critical: A battery at or below this percentage is critical.
data_description.quiet_threshold_hours: Hours without any report before a device is quiet.
data_description.quiet_scope: Battery devices announce themselves; mains devices usually go unavailable instead.
data_description.integration_thresholds: Integrations whose devices report less often, such as Z-Wave sleepers or blinds, can have a longer threshold.

filters.name: Filters
filters.description: Leave everything empty to watch every device.

data_description.include_areas: Devices without an area are left out when this is set.
data_description.exclude_entities: For example a settings sensor an integration labels as a battery.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: A message when a device enters a state (goes offline, goes quiet, drops to warning or critical), never on every update. Leave the targets empty for no notifications; the pulse_check_transition event fires either way.

data.weekly_all_clear: Weekly "all clear" when there is nothing to report

data_description.notify_critical: Default delivery for offline devices and critical batteries. A device's own setting overrides it.
data_description.notify_warning: Default delivery for quiet devices and low batteries.
data_description.reminder_days: Days an instant notification may stay unresolved before it is sent again.

data_description.per_device_sensors: Adds a diagnostic "Battery days left" and "Battery last replaced" sensor to every battery device.

error.critical_above_warning: The critical level must not be higher than the warning level.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Mute a device for a while. Its facts are still reported, but it counts as OK and sends no notifications.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device id, or the entity id of a battery sensor that has no device.

days.name: Days
days.description: How long to snooze for. Default 7.

until.name: Until
until.description: An exact end time instead of a number of days.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device id, or the entity id of a battery sensor that has no device.

set_device_settings.name: Set device settings
set_device_settings.description: Change what Pulse Check knows about one device. Only the fields given are changed; an empty value clears that setting.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device id, or the entity id of a battery sensor that has no device.

name.name: Display name
name.description: Shown instead of the registry name. Does not rename the device.

area.name: Area
area.description: Shown instead of the registry area and used by the area filters.

quiet_threshold_hours.name: Quiet after
quiet_threshold_hours.description: Hours without a report before this device is quiet.

battery_count.name: Battery count
battery_count.description: How many cells the device takes.

rechargeable.name: Rechargeable
rechargeable.description: Charge it rather than replace it.

notify_policy.name: Notification policy
notify_policy.description: How to deliver this device's notifications, overriding the defaults by severity.

mark_replaced.name: Mark battery replaced
mark_replaced.description: Record that the battery was replaced now, closing the current cycle.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device id, or the entity id of a battery sensor that has no device.

battery_type.name: Battery type
battery_type.description: What went in, for the record.

mark_charged.name: Mark battery charged
mark_charged.description: Record that the battery was charged now, closing the current cycle.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The device id, or the entity id of a battery sensor that has no device.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Recompute now and re-read battery history from the recorder.

not_loaded.message: Pulse Check is not set up.

unknown_device.message: Pulse Check does not know a device "{device_id}".
